lines.text: Price? Say what, not how much!
Many learners say: How much is the price?
Use what with the word price.
What! What is the price of this bag?

data.why: Use what with the word price.

quiz.stem: ___ is the price of this bag?

native.hook: هل تقول “How much is the price?”
native.tip: نقول «كم السعر؟»، أما في الإنجليزية فنقول what مع كلمة price: “What is the price?” وليس “How much is the price?”
native.caption: هل تقول أحيانًا هذه الجملة؟ “How much is the price?” 😅 نقول «كم السعر؟»، أما في الإنجليزية فنقول what مع كلمة price، فالجملة الصحيحة “What is the price?” استمع إلى Carlos وكرّر! تدرّب أكثر في تطبيق Lexkite.

en.hook: Ever say “How much is the price?”
en.tip: In Arabic we say «كم السعر؟», but in English we say what with the word price: “What is the price?” not “How much is the price?”
en.caption: Do you sometimes say this? “How much is the price?” 😅 In Arabic we say «كم السعر؟», but in English we say what with the word price, so the right sentence is “What is the price?” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
